name: EVENTS-001-F01 Create and inspect local events

background.text: the phone time zone is UTC
the phone language is English United States

scenarios.name: EVENTS-001-S39 Timed events require an explicitly chosen hour

steps.text: the owner opened event creation with + for Dentist on 2027-02-06
the owner switches to timed mode without confirming an hour
no implicit timed hour is adopted
a timed event cannot be saved until an hour is chosen
the owner abandons the editor
no event was created on 2027-02-06

scenarios.name: EVENTS-001-S01 Open the form with contextual defaults

steps.text: <view> displays the period containing <view_date>
the owner opens event creation with +
the form date is <default_date>
the title and description are empty
all-day and no repetition are selected
no duration, event end-time or event end-date adjustment is offered

scenarios.name: EVENTS-001-S02 Save an all-day event and return to the originating view

steps.text: <view> displays the period containing 2027-01-20
the owner creates Picnic with + as all-day on 2027-02-06 with description Bring papers
<view> displays the period containing 2027-02-06
Picnic is represented on 2027-02-06
the owner opens Picnic details
the details show title Picnic and description Bring papers
the details show one all-day date 2027-02-06 without a requested hour

scenarios.name: EVENTS-001-S03 Create a timed event offline with an automatic hour

steps.text: the phone has no network connection and no Google Play services
Day displays the period containing 2027-02-06
the owner creates Dentist with + at 09:30 on 2027-02-06 without a description
Day displays the period containing 2027-02-06
Dentist is represented at 09:30 on 2027-02-06
the owner opens Dentist details
the details show an empty description
the computed interval is 2027-02-06 09:30 to 2027-02-06 10:30 in UTC
the computed duration is 60 elapsed minutes
no sign-in, network or shared Android calendar is required

scenarios.name: EVENTS-001-S04 Reject missing mandatory event input

steps.text: the owner opened event creation with + for 2027-02-06
the owner attempts to save a timed event at 09:30 with title input <title_input>
the editor remains open and identifies the title as required
the owner abandons the editor
no event was created on 2027-02-06

scenarios.name: EVENTS-001-S05 Abandoning a draft restores the original calendar period

steps.text: Month displays the period containing 2027-01-20
the owner opened event creation with +
the draft is Draft at 10:00 on 2027-02-06 with description Unsaved
the owner abandons the editor using <action>
Month displays the period containing 2027-01-20
the owner navigates to 2027-02-06
no event named Draft exists

scenarios.name: EVENTS-001-S06 Empty time slots do not open event creation

steps.text: <view> displays the period containing 2027-02-06
the owner taps an empty time slot at 09:30 on 2027-02-06
<view> remains active with no event editor open
no event was created on 2027-02-06
